retrieval.vector_num: Number of results from vector similarity search
retrieval.bm25_num: Number of results from BM25 keyword search
retrieval.final_num: Number of final results after reranking
retrieval.vector_weight: Weight for vector channel in fusion (0.0-1.0). Higher value = more emphasis on semantic similarity
retrieval.reranker_weight: Weight controlling keyword reranker influence (0.0-1.0). Higher value = stronger keyword boost
retrieval.html_boost: Additional boost for HTML files (0.0-1.0). Higher value = stronger HTML priority

description.default_package: Default package name to use if not specified in query
description.allow_parameter_override: If false, parameters passed to retrieve_hybrid will be ignored and config file values will be used. If true, parameters can override config file values.
